## The VP Sales Hire: The Most Important and Most Dangerous

A great VP Sales can double revenue in 18 months. A bad one can destroy team morale, burn through pipeline, and cost the company millions.

### Stage-Appropriate Sales Leaders

The sales leader you need depends on your company stage:

| Stage | ARR | Leader Profile | Key Skills |
|---|---|---|---|
| $0-$2M | Pre-PMF | Player-coach | Closing, discovery, process creation |
| $2M-$10M | Initial scale | Builder | Team building, playbook creation, hiring |
| $10M-$30M | Growth | Optimizer | Process refinement, forecasting, enablement |
| $30M-$100M | Scale | Strategist | Multi-segment, international, M&A support |
| $100M+ | Enterprise | Executive | Board reporting, investor relations, org design |

### The Interview Process

#### Round 1: Experience Deep Dive (60 min)

Questions:

- "Walk me through your revenue history. What was revenue when you started vs. when you left each role?"
- "How did you build your team at [company]? How many people did you hire? How many succeeded?"
- "Describe a quarter where you missed target. What happened and what did you do?"

#### Round 2: Sales Methodology (60 min)

- "What sales methodology do you follow? How have you implemented it?"
- "Show me a pipeline review process. How do you inspect deals?"
- "How do you forecast? What accuracy do you achieve?"

#### Round 3: Case Study (90 min)

Present a real scenario:

- Here is our product, market, and current sales data
- Build a 90-day plan
- Present to the hiring team

#### Round 4: Reference Checks (Critical)

For sales leaders, references are paramount:

- Talk to 5+ people: former managers, peers, AND direct reports
- Ask: "Would you follow this person to their next company?"
- Verify revenue claims against actual results

### Red Flags

- Cannot provide specific revenue numbers
- Blames team or market for misses
- Has never personally closed complex deals
- Focuses on hiring without demonstrating coaching ability
- Compensation expectations disconnected from company stage

### Compensation Benchmarks

| Level | Base | OTE | Equity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sales Manager | $120K-$150K | $200K-$280K | 0.1-0.3% |
| Director of Sales | $150K-$180K | $280K-$350K | 0.2-0.5% |
| VP Sales | $180K-$250K | $350K-$500K | 0.5-1.5% |
| CRO | $250K-$350K | $500K-$800K+ | 1-3% |
